• Act as a key point of contact for law enforcement agencies and relevant government authorities across the UAE, including Dubai Police and other local law enforcement bodies.

  • Receive, assess and coordinate responses to requests for user, transaction and other information from authorised law enforcement agencies, ensuring requests are handled in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

  • Establish and maintain strong, professional relationships with UAE law enforcement agencies, regulators and government stakeholders.

  • Work closely with internal Legal, Compliance, Investigations, Security, Risk and Operations teams to assess requests, obtain relevant information and coordinate timely responses.

  • Review and validate law enforcement requests to ensure they contain the appropriate information and legal basis required for Binance to respond.

  • Coordinate the collection, preservation and secure disclosure of relevant information and data in response to valid requests.

  • Maintain accurate records of law enforcement requests, responses, correspondence and relevant case information.

  • Support investigations involving fraud, financial crime, money laundering, sanctions, cybercrime and other illicit activity where Binance's assistance is requested by authorised authorities.

  • Identify trends, recurring issues and emerging risks from law enforcement requests and share relevant insights with internal stakeholders.

  • Support the development and improvement of processes, procedures and guidance for managing law enforcement requests in the UAE.

  • Help educate and advise internal teams on UAE law enforcement engagement, information requests and appropriate response processes.

  • Ensure all interactions and disclosures are handled with a high degree of confidentiality, professionalism and discretion.

  • Stay up to date with relevant UAE laws, regulations, law enforcement practices and developments affecting digital assets and cryptocurrency.

• Experience working with UAE law enforcement agencies, regulators or government authorities, ideally in a role involving information requests, investigations or financial crime.

  • Strong understanding of the UAE law enforcement and regulatory environment, with existing relationships or experience engaging with Dubai Police and/or other UAE authorities highly desirable.

  • Experience handling requests for information, subpoenas, production orders, court orders or similar legal/government requests.

  • Background in law enforcement, government, financial crime, compliance, investigations, legal or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of AML, financial crime, fraud, cybercrime or cryptocurrency-related investigations is highly desirable.

  • Experience working with sensitive, confidential and potentially high-risk information.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both government authorities and internal cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and cases simultaneously while working to tight deadlines.

  • Strong attention to detail and sound judgement when assessing sensitive requests and information.

  • Fluency in English and Arabic is required.

  • Experience in the cryptocurrency, digital asset, fintech or financial services industry is preferred.

We are looking for an experienced Pakistan-based MLRO to support Binance Pakistan’s growth in the region. The role will be responsible for building and maintaining the local AML/CFT, KYC, sanctions and regulatory compliance framework, with a strong focus on Pakistan’s financial crime regulatory environment and virtual asset requirements set out by the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (“PVARA”).

  • Develop, implement and maintain the Pakistan compliance programme, covering AML/CFT, KYC/CDD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity reporting, and regulatory governance.

  • Act as the local MLRO/primary financial crime compliance point of contact for the Pakistan entity, including oversight of suspicious transaction identification, escalation and reporting.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable Pakistan laws, regulations and regulatory expectations, including AML/CFT requirements, FMU reporting obligations, sanctions requirements, and any PVARA VASP licensing conditions.

  • Support the PVARA licensing process or ongoing licence obligations, including preparation of policies, procedures, regulatory submissions, governance documents and responses to regulatory queries.

  • Liaise with relevant Pakistani regulatory and law enforcement stakeholders and competent authorities.

  • Conduct enterprise-wide and product-level AML/CFT risk assessments, identifying control gaps and recommending practical remediation plans.

  • Work closely with global and regional compliance, legal, investigations, sanctions, onboarding and product teams to ensure Pakistan requirements are properly embedded into Binance’s global control framework.

  • Provide compliance advice on new products, customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, local partnerships and operational changes impacting the Pakistan business.

  • Deliver training to local staff on AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, suspicious activity reporting, regulatory expectations and compliance culture.

  • Drive continuous improvement of the local compliance framework, ensuring it remains effective, scalable and suitable for a fast-moving fintech / virtual assets environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in AML/CFT, compliance, financial crime, regulatory affairs or MLRO-type roles, ideally within Pakistan’s financial services, fintech, payments, banking, brokerage, EMI, crypto or virtual assets sector.

  • Strong understanding of Pakistan’s AML/CFT framework, including KYC/CDD, STR/CTR reporting, sanctions compliance, transaction monitoring and regulatory engagement.

  • Familiarity with Pakistani regulators and authorities, including relevant law enforcement or supervisory bodies.

  • Experience supporting licensing, regulatory inspections, audits, policy development or compliance programme implementation.

  • Prior experience in a start-up, fintech, payments, digital assets, crypto, or high-growth technology business is strongly preferred.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with regulators, senior management, global teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex regulatory and financial crime matters clearly and practically.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a hands-on approach to identifying, managing and remediating compliance risks.

  • Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, ACAMS, CFE or equivalent would be an advantage.

lists.content:
• Design and maintain comprehensive Web/App test cases and test plans covering functionality, compatibility, and interaction
  • Develop and maintain UI/API automated tests using Java, Python, or JavaScript to ensure high coverage and reliability
  • Combine automation and manual exploratory testing to validate user scenarios and discover potential experience issues
  • Perform root cause analysis on test failures and production issues, and drive fixes to closure
  • Identify blind spots in test coverage and continuously improve automation effectiveness
  • Participate in testing for new features — define expected behaviors, system impact, and risk points from a user-experience perspective
  • Conduct App compatibility testing across devices, OS versions, and screen sizes, as well as Web cross-browser and cross-resolution testing
  • Participate in performance testing (page load time, App cold start / warm start, etc.) and ensure stability under high-concurrency and weak-network scenarios

• Strong coding ability in at least one of Java, Python, or JavaScript (live coding assessment required)
  • Extensive Web/App automation testing experience with tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, etc.
  • Solid understanding of Web/App testing methodologies and automation framework design
  • Proficiency in SQL for data validation and issue troubleshooting
  • Proven root cause analysis ability to solve complex quality problems
  • Familiarity with Web front-end technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) and mobile platform fundamentals (Android/iOS architecture and characteristics)
  • Experience building testing tools, platforms, or quality infrastructure

Background:

  • 1–5 years of QA or test development experience, including at least 1 year of Web or App automation testing
  • Strong coding skills — able to write code from scratch, not just scripts
  • Proficient in SQL for independent data validation and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on mobile or Web testing experience
    • Core Competencies:
  • Automation capability: Can design and develop automation frameworks, not just use existing tools
  • Root cause analysis: Can trace test failures or production issues back to their root cause
  • SQL & data validation: Can write complex SQL to verify data consistency and troubleshoot data-related bugs
  • Cross-platform understanding: Understands Web/App architecture, including front-end/back-end interaction, network requests, cache mechanisms, and WebView
  • UX sensitivity: Can identify experience issues from the user's perspective, not just whether functionality works
  • Test tooling: Experience building test platforms, tools, or quality infrastructure
  • Collaboration drive: Can push developers to fix issues rather than passively waiting

    • Soft Skills:

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented
  • "Destructive thinking" mindset — adept at finding system weaknesses
  • Strong communication — bridges developers and product managers
  • Quality ownership mentality — treats quality as personal responsibility

• Payment, transaction, or financial system QA experience
  • AI tooling usage experience
  • Crypto / Web3 industry background
  • Hands-on App compatibility testing experience using cloud device platforms such as Testin or WeTest
  • Weak-network testing experience using tools such as Charles or Fiddler

job_detail_fetch.descriptionPlain:
Superside is hiring an Account Director to lead and grow a portfolio of strategically important enterprise customers. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sale scoping through delivery, renewal, and expansion, ensuring customers see Superside as a long-term creative partner.

This role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, commercial growth, and delivery. You’ll lead cross-functional teams, manage senior stakeholders, and drive retention, expansion, and high-quality delivery across complex accounts.
job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is hiring an Account Director to lead and grow a portfolio of strategically important enterprise customers. You’ll own the full customer lifecycle, from pre-sale scoping through delivery, renewal, and expansion, ensuring customers see Superside as a long-term creative partner.

This role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, commercial growth, and delivery. You’ll lead cross-functional teams, manage senior stakeholders, and drive retention, expansion, and high-quality delivery across complex accounts.

lists.content:
• Own the end-to-end relationship for 5–10 enterprise customers, driving retention, expansion, and executive trust.
  • Develop and execute account growth strategies, identifying upgrade and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead renewals and commercial negotiations in partnership with leadership.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and procurement teams.
  • Translate customer goals into scalable creative programs and solutions.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Producers to ensure seamless delivery across workstreams.
  • Act as the senior escalation point, resolving issues quickly and maintaining customer confidence.
  • Monitor account health, burn rates, and pacing to ensure performance and profitability.
  • Develop ROI-driven business cases that demonstrate the value of Superside’s model.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve customer outcomes.
  • Coach and develop PMs and Producers to raise the bar on delivery and customer management.
  • Partner with Creative, Product, and Operations to align on resourcing and execution.

• 5–10+ years of experience in account management or client services in creative, marketing, or digital environments.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing enterprise or high-value global accounts.
  • 3–5+ years in an account leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Manager, Group Account Manager, or equivalent).
  • Strong commercial acumen with ownership of revenue, retention, and growth targets.
  • Experience working with enterprise, SaaS, D2C, or B2B clients.
  • Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders and navigate complex organizations.
  • Experience leading and developing cross-functional teams.
  • Strong operational mindset with the ability to scale delivery while maintaining quality.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into actionable programs and outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills with a structured, solution-oriented approach.

job_detail_fetch.descriptionPlain:
Superside is looking for a talented Conceptual Art Director with a passion for Generative AI to create bold, high-performing digital campaigns for top global brands. In this role, you’ll partner with copywriters, strategists and creatives to deliver concept-driven ideas across social media, web, video, and more—bringing big ideas to life with strong art direction and design execution.
 
You’ll thrive in a collaborative, globally distributed team and contribute to work that’s not only creatively exciting but also strategically sharp. This is a role for someone who can think big, execute beautifully, and bring a deep understanding of design to everything they do.

lists.content:
• Partner with copywriters and strategists to develop compelling creative campaigns across digital-first channels (social, web, video) with the ability to stretch into ATL (TV, print, OOH).
  • Lead art direction for creative campaigns and video concepts, providing visual direction from ideation through final execution.
  • Design or direct the creation of digital assets, mood boards, layouts, and visual frameworks that bring brand narratives to life.
  • Integrate AI-assisted assets into workflows while maintaining brand integrity and emotional impact.
  • Contribute to brand storytelling by developing concept-led brand systems and integrated creative ideas.
  • Build and present creative decks that clearly communicate concepts and strategy to customers.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Leads, Project Managers, and other creatives across time zones.
  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously, consistently delivering on time, on budget, and to the highest quality.
  • Help push creative boundaries, championing fresh ideas and evolving Superside’s conceptual capabilities.
  • Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to understand goals and deliver work that drives results.
  • Contribute to a culture of excellence, experimentation, and continuous creative growth.

• 5+ years of experience in concept-driven roles within creative agencies or fast-paced in-house teams.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing concept-first thinking and excellent art direction across digital platforms.
  • Proficient in using AI tools as part of a thoughtful and intentional creative workflow.
  • Passion for creativity and a strong eye for design, typography, layout, and visual storytelling.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence presenting ideas to customers and internal teams.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with experience juggling multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Growth mindset and curiosity, always seeking new tools, trends, and ways to improve your craft.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing and performance creative principles.
  • A collaborative and inclusive approach to working with diverse teams and perspectives.

job_detail_fetch.descriptionPlain:
Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries.
This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.
job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries.

This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

lists.content:
• Design across branding, campaigns, and digital platforms: logos, visual identity systems, social and display content, presentations, web and landing pages, and more.
  • Use generative AI tools & models (e.g. Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc.) throughout your process: concepting, ideation, image generation, layout exploration, and production to move faster without sacrificing craft.
  • Translate creative briefs into polished, on-brand visual concepts, iterating based on feedback from creative leads and clients.
  • Maintain and evolve visual identity systems, ensuring consistency across deliverables and touchpoints.
  • Apply strong fundamentals such as typography, layout, color, and composition to produce work that is both conceptually sharp and production-ready.
  • Know where AI-assisted output needs a human hand to protect brand integrity, craft quality, and emotional resonance, and refine accordingly.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Leads, Project Managers, and fellow designers across multiple concurrent projects and accounts.
  • Give and receive constructive creative feedback in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Stay current on new AI tools and workflows as they emerge, and share techniques and learnings with the wider design team.
  • Manage your time and priorities across multiple projects, meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality.

• 4+ years of experience as a designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong conceptual thinking and visual craft across brand, campaign, and digital work.
  • Hands-on, current experience with generative AI creative tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc as a required, everyday part of your workflow, not a nice-to-have.
  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.
  • Solid grounding in design fundamentals: typography, layout, color theory, and visual hierarchy.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to interpret briefs and explain design decisions clearly.
  • A collaborative mindset, comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and working across distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Self-motivation and comfort working independently in a remote-first environment.

This role focuses on outbound sales and engagement with enterprise-level accounts in the SaaS, creative, and marketing industries, driving our expansion in the North American market (U.S. & Canada).

job_detail_fetch.description:
Superside is hiring a Solutions Engineer to be the technical partner to our Account Executives and Account Managers before a deal closes. You’ll find out what a client really needs, work out what is technically possible, and design the solution that delivers it, whether the answer is using our creative services team, an AI system, or both.

 

You start from the customer’s problem, not the product. You understand how this work gets built, you’ve built something yourself, and you can explain how a solution you propose would work across our systems and services with credibility. You’ll report to the Head of FDE and work closely with AEs, AMs, AI Deployment Strategists, engineering, and Product.

lists.content:
• Join discovery calls with Account Executives and Account Managers to find the real business problem behind a client’s request.

  • Decide whether the answer is creative talent, a system, or both, and match it to our product portfolio, services, and AI tooling partners.  

  • Design the solution architecture, then scope, price, and write the proposal for systems deals, with engineering and studio input.

  • Take every systems deal through the systems review before engineers are assigned.

  • Hand sold work to AI Deployment Strategists for delivery, with clear briefs to engineering and studio teams.

  • Stay close to larger enterprise accounts after the sale as the leadership voice of the original deal.

  • Spot needs that keep recurring and that our portfolio doesn’t cover, and feed them into the product roadmap review.

  • Build reusable sales assets (discovery guides, scoping and pricing templates, proposal modules) and run enablement sessions so AEs and AMs can spot and qualify systems opportunities on their own.

• 3+ years in a client-facing role, such as solutions engineering, technical sales, consulting, product, or forward deployed engineering.

  • Strong consultative selling skills and real customer empathy: you dig into a customer’s needs, problems, and systems before you propose anything.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic software development: you’ve built an agent or a common workflow yourself. You don’t need to be a software engineer.

  • Ability to map out the solution and match available tools to customer problems.

  • A customer-facing or sales background combined with technical depth: you can speak credibly about what the client needs and how it gets delivered.

  • Experience pricing and scoping deals under real timelines, and working with sales, product, and engineering teams.

  • High agency: you take ownership and figure things out.

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.

  • Bonus: enterprise deal experience, performance marketing or adtech, creative industry experience, founding experience, or AI tools for design and creative.
